The table shows the stock data for a particular company over a period of time. Each row represents a different trading day, with information on the date, opening price, highest price of the day, lowest price of the day, closing price or last price, and the volume of shares traded on that day.

From the data, we can see that the stock has been fairly stable with minor fluctuations in the opening and closing prices over the days listed. The highest price recorded was $64.1 on 12/22/2016, while the lowest price was $62.03 on 12/30/2016.

The volume of shares traded on each day varies, with some days having higher trading volume than others. For instance, on 12/16/2016, the volume traded was 42,452,660, while on 12/29/2016, it was only 10,248,460.

Overall, the stock seems to have been trading within a certain range during the period covered by the table, with a gradual increase in the closing price from $62.3 on 12/16/2016 to $62.3 on 01/04/2017. The stock's performance can be analyzed further by looking at additional data points and trends over a longer period of time.
